sampling.prompt_universe: First 300 file-order items from original S.prompts validation filters; do not refill skipped items or select based on model outcomes. Preserve all 300 item dispositions.

judging.orders: Both unchanged planner orders for every generated eligible request
judging.binding: Fresh held-out dataset/cache/ledger/profile binding, distinct from training and CLI caches
judging.unknown_or_failed_ranking: Stop and preserve raw evidence and reservation; no automatic exclusion, fabricated rank, tie or retry

budget_migration.rule: Before held-out binding, independently replay completed training and both prior ledgers. Count actual costs and retained unknown ceilings from each disjoint ledger once, plus original legacy CLI known costs and unknown ceilings. Freeze final hashes in a separately adopted instance manifest. Never add the training ledger contract legacy subtotal a second time. Stage allowance is at most $25 and cumulative costs remain at most $200. No future reserve remains because this is the originally reserved gate.

verdict.win: Both orders agree on same model; otherwise an order-disagreement tie
verdict.adopt: DPO share of decided prompts exceeds 0.5 and Wilson 95% lower bound exceeds 0.5, and all other four frozen gates pass
verdict.incomplete_judging: Not a gate verdict; halt and retain evidence
verdict.report: Registered 300-item universe, every skip, eligible requests, both-order coverage, wins/ties/decided denominator, interval and failures

allowed_later_instance_bindings: Exact policy and reference checkpoint hashes
Exact vocabulary and model specification hashes
Exact eligible sampled request file and original 300-item disposition receipt hashes
Final immutable training and prior ledger hashes and independently replayed cumulative accounting
Fresh cache/ledger binding and exact source-bound operational runner/admission receipt
scientific_or_profile_changes_after_outc: Forbidden without separately named amendment preserving this frozen policy and original verdict
remaining_before_dispatch: Root independent review and adoption before DPO outcomes
Actual completed preference training and all registered sample outputs
Separately source-bound operational runner with fail-stop/memory controls and tests; no launch interface is supplied by this stage core
Final instance and accounting migration review through root; existing watchdog owns launch
